# skycloak_theme_assignment (Resource)

Realm-level custom theme assignment per Keycloak theme type. A singleton per realm; managing this resource asserts the full assignment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an uploaded custom theme by name.
data "skycloak_themes" "all" {
  cluster_id = skycloak_cluster.production.id
}

locals {
  corporate_theme = one([for t in data.skycloak_themes.all.themes : t.id if t.name == "corporate"])
}

resource "skycloak_theme_assignment" "app" {
  cluster_id = skycloak_cluster.production.id
  realm_name = skycloak_realm.app.name

  login = local.corporate_theme
  # account, admin, email omitted -> Keycloak built-in defaults
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster ID. Immutable.
- `realm_name` (String) Realm name. Immutable.

### Optional

- `account` (String) Custom theme ID to activate for the account console. Omit to use Keycloak's built-in default.
- `admin` (String) Custom theme ID to activate for the admin console. Omit to use Keycloak's built-in default.
- `email` (String) Custom theme ID to activate for the email templates. Omit to use Keycloak's built-in default.
- `login` (String) Custom theme ID to activate for the login page. Omit to use Keycloak's built-in default.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite ID `cluster_id/realm_name/theme_assignment`.
